datasets.name: Sentinel-1 SAR images
datasets.verbatim: We used SAR and optical images derived from Sentinel-1 and -2, which captured landslides caused by the earthquake on 14 April 2016, as training data

datasets.name: Google Earth imagery
datasets.verbatim: Previously vegetated areas can be found by using Google maps, which were created with remote sensing satellite data or aerial photos previously.

methods.name: pix2pixHD+
methods.summary: A modified pix2pixHD architecture that incorporates a spatial attention mechanism into the generator's loss function to preserve high-frequency components and enhance spatial resolution during SAR-to-optical image translation, followed by landslide classification using EfficientNetV2.
methods.source: Kohei Arai, Yushin Nakaoka, and Hiroshi Okumura
methods.verbatim: This method is renamed as “pix2pixHD+” hereafter. ... The code for spatial attention is as follows Listing 1.

availability.author_statement: The original contributions presented in the study are included in the article, further inquiries can be directed to the corresponding author.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code for the pix2pixHD+ method is not provided via a repository or persistent link.
